result.instructions: Tools for Recruitee, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recruitee data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run recruitee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recruitee_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recruitee_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. recruitee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recruitee_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Recruitee user the API token belongs to — name, email, role, role abilities and company id. A cheap way to confirm the token and company id are right. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/admin.

tools.name: recruitee_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the company's team members (memberships): admin_id, role, whether they are a recruiter or hiring manager, and the jobs they can access. Use admin_id values for task assignees and filters. User names/emails are in the `references` array. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/memberships.

role_id.description: Only members with this role id.

tools.name: recruitee_search_candidates
tools.title: Search candidates
tools.description: Search the company's candidates with Recruitee's candidate search (the same engine as the app's filters). `query` is a free-text search across name, emails, phones, tags, sources, job assignments, current stage, cover letter and CV content. `filters` accepts Recruitee filter objects verbatim, e.g. {"field":"created_at","gte":1548975600} (Unix seconds), {"field":"has_cv","eq":true}, {"filter":"tags","id":{"in":[12]}}, {"filter":"stages","name":{"in":["Phone interview"]}}. Returns `hits` (with each candidate's placements: job + current stage) and `total`. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/search/new/candidates.

filters.description: Additional Recruitee search filter objects, sent as filters_json.

sort_by.description: Sort key with _asc or _desc suffix, e.g. created_at_desc (default), relevance_desc, candidate_name_asc, candidate_rating_desc, candidate_stage_name_asc.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates, newest first, optionally narrowed to one job, a name/job search, qualified or disqualified only, specific ids, or those created after a date. Paginate with limit + offset (next offset = offset + limit). Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates.

offer_id.description: Only candidates on this job/talent pool.

query.description: Search by candidate name or job.

created_after.description: Only candidates created after this date (ISO 8601).

tools.name: recruitee_get_candidate
tools.title: Get one candidate
tools.description: Fetch one candidate's full profile: contact details, sources, tags, cover letter, CV URL, custom fields, ratings, and `placements` — one per job they are on, each with its placement id and current stage. The placement id is what recruitee_move_candidate_stage needs. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidate_notes
tools.title: List a candidate's notes
tools.description: List the notes on a candidate's profile, with replies, author admin_id and visibility. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.

tools.name: recruitee_list_offers
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the company's jobs (Recruitee calls them offers) with id, title, status, slug, department_id, recruiter_id, hiring_manager_id and pipeline_template_id. Filter by status, department, location, recruiter, hiring manager, tag and more; add heavy fields with `include` (e.g. counters for candidate counts, description, salary, location_ids). Paginated with limit + page (default 1000 per page); `meta.total_count` gives the total. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers.

recruiter_ids.description: Only jobs with these recruiters (admin ids).

hiring_manager_ids.description: Only jobs with these hiring managers (admin ids).

tag_ids.description: Only jobs with these job tags.

employment_types.description: Only these employment types, e.g. fulltime.

categories.description: Only these job categories, e.g. information_technology.

lang_codes.description: Only jobs in these languages, e.g. en.

tools.name: recruitee_get_offer
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch one job or talent pool by id with its full details: description, requirements, location, salary, employment type, candidate counters and pipeline_template_id. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/offers/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_get_pipeline_template
tools.title: Get a hiring pipeline
tools.description: Fetch a pipeline template with its ordered stages (id, name, group, category). A job's `pipeline_template_id` (from recruitee_list_offers / recruitee_get_offer) names its pipeline; the stage ids here are what recruitee_move_candidate_stage takes. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/pipeline_templates/{id}.

tools.name: recruitee_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments with their ids and job counts. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/departments.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tags
tools.title: List candidate tags
tools.description: List the company's candidate tags with ids and usage counts. Tag ids are used in recruitee_search_candidates filters. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tags.

tools.name: recruitee_list_disqualify_reasons
tools.title: List disqualify reasons
tools.description: List the company's configured disqualification reasons (id, name, position). Useful for reading why candidates were disqualified. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/disqualify_reasons.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List recruiting tasks (title, description, due date, completed, candidate_id). With candidate_id, lists that candidate's tasks (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tasks — only `status` applies). Otherwise lists company tasks with scope, assignee, sorting and paging (Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/tasks).

admin_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these admin ids (company list only).

tools.name: recruitee_list_interview_events
tools.title: List interviews
tools.description: List scheduled interview events (candidate_id, offer_id, stage_id, start time, duration, location, attendees). Defaults to upcoming events for the whole company; narrow by candidate, date range or interviewer. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/events.

admin_ids.description: Only events assigned to these admin ids.

timezone.description: Timezone for the date range, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

page.description: Page number; only used together with limit.

tools.name: recruitee_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluations
tools.description: List interview results — evaluations (rating + note) and questionnaire scorecards — optionally for one candidate or by selected reviewers. Recruitee: GET /c/{company_id}/interview/results.

admin_ids.description: Only results by these admin ids.

page.description: Page number; only used together with limit.

tools.name: recruitee_create_candidate
tools.title: Create a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a candidate manually (as if a recruiter added them in the app — no auto-confirmation email is sent), optionally assigning them straight to one or more jobs in the job's default stage. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates.

remote_cv_url.description: Public URL of the CV file for Recruitee to fetch.

offer_ids.description: Jobs/talent pools to assign the candidate to (default stage).

tools.name: recruitee_update_candidate
tools.title: Update a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: update a candidate's name or contact details. Only the fields you pass change; list fields (emails, phones, links) REPLACE the existing list, so pass the full list you want. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/candidates/{id}.

emails.description: Full replacement list of email addresses.

phones.description: Full replacement list of phone numbers.

social_links.description: Full replacement list of social profile URLs.

links.description: Full replacement list of other links.

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_note
tools.title: Add a note to a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a candidate's profile, visible to the team. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a candidate

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_tags
tools.title: Tag a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more tags to a candidate (existing tags are reused by name; new names create new tags). Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/tags.

tags.description: Tag names to add, e.g. ["Python developer"].

tools.name: recruitee_assign_candidate_to_offer
tools.title: Add a candidate to a job
tools.description: WRITE: put an existing candidate on a job (or talent pool) — creates a placement in the pipeline's first stage. Pass exactly one of offer_id or talent_pool_id. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/placements.

annotations.title: Add a candidate to a job

tools.name: recruitee_move_candidate_stage
tools.title: Move a candidate to another stage
tools.description: WRITE: move a candidate to another stage of a job's pipeline. Takes the PLACEMENT id (from recruitee_get_candidate → placements[].id, one per job) and the destination stage id (from recruitee_get_pipeline_template). Moving to a 'hired' stage also requires work_location_id. Stage automations configured in Recruitee may run. Undo by moving back. Recruitee: PATCH /c/{company_id}/placements/{id}/change_stage.

placement_id.description: The placement id (candidate-on-job), not the candidate id.

work_location_id.description: Location id — required by Recruitee when the destination is a hired stage.

annotations.title: Move a candidate to another stage

tools.name: recruitee_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a recruiting task, optionally about a candidate, assigned to team members (admin ids from recruitee_list_team_members), with an optional due date. Recruitee: POST /c/{company_id}/tasks.

timezone.description: Timezone of the due date, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.
